info.name: Lido Ethereum APR for Eth and stEth Rewards API

params.name: currency
params.description: Fiat currency to use for calculations. USD by default.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return. Max value is 10000.

params.name: archiveRate
params.description: Use an exchange rate close to transaction time in curency calculations. True by default.

params.name: onlyRewards
params.description: Include only rewards without transfers or stakings. False by default.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort of transactions by blockTime. Desc by default.
